experiment: 019-source-diversity (E10, Amendment 19 of docs/04-phase4-plan.md; exploratory under D-016/D-017)
feature_layout: 004 secondary = [blk4 CLS|blk4 mean|blk8 CLS|blk8 mean|blk12 CLS|blk12 mean], H=768; block 12 == B0 primary

WMC.source_dataset: Wikimedia Commons quality images (1600 px thumbnail)

HDRP.source_dataset: Google HDR+ burst dataset final.jpg (2017-10-23 pipeline)

new_split.by: group; whole groups assigned in the order of a seeded permutation of sorted group ids, first-fit into train, then calib, then test (largest remaining room if none fits)

ctl.target: mean (over the k=2 subsets of the other sources) of the summed train-role real counts of the subset
ctl.by: whole groups (D.groups: device / caption family / image / group), greedy over a seeded permutation, a group is skipped if it would overshoot the target; fakes unchanged

labels.DIVERSITY_HELPS: mean over held-out sources of [AUROC(k=5) - mean over k=2 subsets of AUROC] >= 0.03 with bootstrap CI lo > 0, AND mean FPR difference (same pairing) has CI hi < 0
labels.DIVERSITY_NOT_QUANTITY: DIVERSITY_HELPS and the size-matched k=5 control (mean of 5 seeds) also meets the AUROC part (>= 0.03, CI lo > 0) against the k=2 mean
labels.DISCOVERY: every held-out source AUROC >= 0.90 and FPR <= 5% at k=5 AND DIVERSITY_HELPS
labels.E7_RULE: Amendment 16 exactly: KILL if any source AUROC < 0.75 or FPR > 10%; PASS if every source AUROC >= 0.85 and FPR <= 5%, mean(F_b8-F_last) >= 0.03 with CI lo > 0, and the mean AUROC at k=5 exceeds the mean AUROC at EACH of k=1..4 with CI lo > 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
labels.KILL_OF_LINE: DIVERSITY_HELPS AUROC difference CI lo <= 0, OR any held-out source at k=5 AUROC < 0.75 or FPR > 10%

fpr_threshold_readings.A: 1% FPR on the training sources' calib reals' CLEAN scores, applied at jpeg75_resize05 (headline)
fpr_threshold_readings.B: 1% FPR on the training sources' calib reals scored under the SAME condition (sensitivity)

bootstrap: 1,000 replicates, one global plan; clusters drawn with replacement within each kind: fam (caption family: RAISE reals + all fakes), dev (VISION), img (OI), one kind per new source (group). Draw order fam, dev, img first, so the plan is identical to E7's on the E7 rows (paired differences with E7).
train: lib/probe.fit_probe, balanced, StratifiedGroupKFold groups: device (VISION) / family id (RAISE) / image (OI) / group (new sources); T-aug copies share their source's group; same as E7
